name: ten-four
title: Ten Four
description: A shelf of clean, copyable snippets pushed from your terminal or Claude Code. "10-4, copy that": copy them out of Raycast with pristine formatting, no mangled line breaks.
author: jaymcc

commands.name: ten-four
commands.title: Ten Four Shelf
commands.subtitle: Copy that
commands.description: Browse and copy snippets pushed to your shelf

commands.name: install-cli
commands.title: Install Ten Four CLI
commands.description: Install the `tenfour` command-line tool so your terminal and Claude Code can push snippets

preferences.name: shelfUrl
preferences.title: Shelf URL
preferences.description: Optional. Leave blank to keep the shelf in a local file (~/.ten-four.json) on this Mac. Set it to an HTTPS Ten Four shelf service endpoint (for example via tailscale serve). HTTP is only supported for loopback testing.

preferences.name: shelfToken
preferences.title: Shelf Token
preferences.description: Required when Shelf URL is set. Must match TENFOUR_TOKEN on the shelf service.
